text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Training starts today too, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"First up is the first leg of the Classic 
Triple Crown, the Satsuki Sho! I'm 
definitely taking it!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's about time for the final push!

Yeah, it's almost time for the final 
stretch!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, for today... We trained 
tailored specifically for Nakayama 
Racecourse, the stage of the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll breeze right through this. Just watch 
me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: RRYAAAAAAAH!!
choice_data_list: You're not hugging the rail, Pokke!
You're not sticking to the inside, Pokke!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Tch, if I dive into the corner at full 
throttle, I end up drifting wide...!

"Jungle Pocket had her strengths and 
weaknesses with corners. Yes, the one she 
struggled with was..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I just can't seem to run right-handed 
tracks well, damn it...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Is that 'cause during my free days, I was 
always running counterclockwise?
choice_data_list:
Plus, they might just have a natural 
aptitude for it.

Plus, they might just have a natural 
aptitude for it.

text_block_list.text:
Umamusume come in all types. Some excel 
clockwise, some counterclockwise, and some 
handle both with ease.

Jungle Pocket was of a lineage better 
suited for wide, left-handed courses.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Even so, complaining won't change 
anything. The Satsuki Sho isn't gonna turn 
into a counterclockwise track just for me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Count on you again tomorrow, Trainer. For 
Fuji-san and your big bro's sake, too!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, let's get used to it as much as we 
can before the real deal.

Yeah, let's get used to it as much as we 
can before the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Guess I'll head home. Still... Fuji-san 
was really great running clockwise.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Both the Asahi Hai FS and the Yayoi Sho 
were electrifying runs. As her junior, I 
want to at least...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hm, voices...? Who's in the PE equipment 
shed...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: It sounds like a familiar voice, but...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ââ!! That's...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Did you understand? Tachyon, and...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I truly hope you will accept my advice on 
your running.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ha, that's nonsense, Fuji-kun. I 
appreciate the sentiment, but—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's fate, simple as that. How could I 
ever cast aside such biologically active 
peptides?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Would that not—be abandoning who we are?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "...Perhaps. Even so, I..."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I want to help her somehow. ...Could you 
put in a word with Tachyon for me as well?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"This is for your own good. Take my word 
for it."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-san... What's the meaning of this? 
Giving guidance to Tachyon...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Tachyon is...! She's our rival, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
My Trainer and I wanted to make Fuji-san's 
dream come true... And yet...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Pokke... Thank you... Yeah. That really 
means a lot to me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I, too, intend to entrust you with 
everything. However, don't put too much 
pressure on yourself— do your best for 
your own sake.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Were those words... a lie...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Are you saying you can't entrust your 
dreams to a rough-around-the-edges, 
freestyle-raised guy like me...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Fuji-san, I... I'm...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I still looked up to the way you 
ran...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
What am I supposed to do? I can't even 
tell Trainer about something like this.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
He's truly carrying his big bro's dream on 
his shoulders. How could I ever throw cold 
water on that...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"What kind of mindset... am I supposed to 
run with...?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I was just looking up to them on my 
own. Still...
